name: Sembly AI
tagline: Sembly AI records, transcribes, and summarises meetings from Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet. It extracts action items, decisions, and risks automatically, then makes meeting insights searchable across your team. Enterprise teams use it to build an institutional memory of decisions made across hundreds of meetings.
